login.title: Channel Partner Login
login.heroTitle: Wedzera bhizinesi rako rezvivakwa nechero lead yaunounza
login.heroIntro: Imwe portal yekunyoresa vatengi nevavaki, chengetedza kiredhiti kune yako madhiri uye uvatevere kusvika pakubhuka.

register.title: Bhalisa inotungamira mumasekonzi
register.text: Tumira mutengi wako uye chirongwa chavari kufarira.

protect.title: Duplicate protection
protect.text: Kutungamira kwako kunoramba kuri kwako kwenguva yekudzivirira, saka hapana mumwe munhu anogona kutora mutengi mumwechete.

track.title: Tarisa nhanho imwe neimwe
track.text: Ona mamiriro emutungamiri wega wega uye nhoroondo yakazara, kubva pakubata kwekutanga kusvika pakurodha.

handover.title: Credit at booking
handover.text: Kana mabhuku emutengi, mutungamiri anopihwa kune muvaki newe akarekodhwa semubatsiri wepamhepo.

login.secure: Chengetedza kusaina - zvevatengi vako zvinogara zvakavanzika

signup.title: Channel Partner Kunyoresa
signup.intro: Gadzira account yako kuti utange kunyoresa uye kugadzirisa ako ega anotungamira.
